messages:
maya: quick check-in — starting a 48h sweep of admin entitlements. Found some odd KMS grants in payments-prod that reference svcacct:`payments-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` possibly duplicate owners

ranjit: link? which key? I saw a spike yesterday in kms access logs

maya: logs: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/ingest-key` — pattern: grant to `svc-payments` and also to `devops-ops` role, appears ownerless in inventory

tj: hmm, that's the one we rotated last month. Can you paste the `gcloud` used to list bindings?

maya: ```
# list bindings
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ingest-key --keyring=payments --location=global --format=json
``` 

alice: I can take payments-prod ownerproof. assigning to @alice :raised_hand:

sofia: heads-up — audit logs show `kms.cryptoKeyVersions.access()` calls 03:12-03:17 UTC yesterday from a GKE nodepool, linking to pod `ingest-worker-7` :eyes:

ranjit: that suggests a mis-scoped service account on the pod template. I'll open a PR to tighten the pod identity

tj: question — do we want to include this key in the entitlement scrub this sprint or triage separately? prefer to scrub ownerless keys now if low risk

maya: lean scrub now. If owner can't be verified within 24h, remove admin bindings and require re-request via access-request workflow. ops-bot, flag this key for 24h hold

ops-bot: [automated] Flagged `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/ingest-key` for 24h hold pending owner verification

alice: :thumbsup: I'll ping payments eng and update the ownerproof doc

security-bot: Reminder: run `rbac-scan --since 30d --filter=admin` and attach the CSV to the ticket

maya: noted. ranjit, can you include the pod spec change and the KMS binding removal in one rollout so we can validate end-to-end?

ranjit: yep, will do a canary in staging then prod. ETA 6h

tj: thanks all — drop short updates in this thread. If anyone sees unexpected failures after binding removal, ping @oncall immediately

alice: update — payments eng confirmed owner is `payments-owners@redwood.com`, will accept ownerproof in 2h

maya: closing the loop after ownerproof recorded. thanks team
